name: Man in a Fox Mask
source: [spoiler]He is Yuuri's real father but he refuses to reveal his name to Shin and Yuuri in the end. His female partner was killed by Tekki long ago. He said that Yuuri's superhuman strength ability was inherited from him while his partner's ability was something related to fire and Yuuri does have some resemblances to her mother.[/spoiler]
